data.one_liner: Combine two icons into a single widget with custom alignment, scaling, and borders.
data.what_it_does: IconCraft extends standard iconography by allowing developers to combine a base icon and a secondary icon into a single widget. It provides customizable borders, precise alignment positioning, and scaling options.
use_when: You need to overlay a badge or auxiliary icon on top of a base icon.
You want to add customized borders and strokes around your icon graphics.
avoid_when: You only need to display a single standard icon without overlays or borders.
You require complex animations or interactive states inside the icon.
strengths: Combines two icons into a single widget seamlessly.
Provides borders with configurable colors, widths, and styles.
Flexible alignment options for positioning the secondary icon.
weaknesses: Limited to combining two icons and applying simple border decorations.
Not documented for platforms beyond basic Flutter rendering.
data.minimal_example:
IconCraft(
  Icon(Icons.email),
  Icon(Icons.notifications),
  alignment: Alignment.topRight,
  decoration: IconDecoration(
    border: IconBorder(color: Colors.white),
  ),
)
